name: web-stdlib-static

cannot_observe.geometry: no layout engine — this verifier parses HTML, it does not render it
cannot_observe.interaction: cannot drive input without a browser
cannot_observe.name-provenance: computing which node supplied the accessible name needs the browser's own name computation
cannot_observe.applied-styles: parses HTML; it has no cascade, so it cannot see which declaration applies or what it references

cannot_establish.interaction: no browser, so no input can be driven
cannot_establish.touch_input: no device to emulate one on

caveats: reads AUTHORED attributes, not computed values — a `role` attribute is checked, the browser's computed role is not
